# GST Calculator India — gstcalculator.me
> Free online GST calculator for Indian businesses, CAs, accountants, and freelancers.
> Covers GST 2.0 slabs (0%, 5%, 18%, 40% effective September 22, 2025), CGST/SGST/IGST split, and reverse GST.
> No login, no signup, no ads in the way. Works in browser, instant results.

## Primary Tool
- https://gstcalculator.me/: Free GST calculator — add GST or remove GST (reverse), choose intra-state (CGST+SGST) or inter-state (IGST), instant breakdown.

## GST 2.0 Key Facts
- GST 2.0 effective: September 22, 2025 (56th GST Council)
- New slabs: 0% (Nil), 5% (essential goods), 18% (standard — most services, electronics, vehicles), 40% (luxury/sin goods)
- Abolished: 12% slab (items moved to 5% or 18%), 28% slab (replaced by 40%)
- Gold: 3% (unchanged), rough diamonds: 0.25% (unchanged)
